snippet.title: SECOND STRIKE: Build a World | Free World War Simulator in Your Browser
snippet.description:
Build a world on the real Earth and watch history happen. Free in your browser: https://secondstrike.io

SECOND STRIKE is a world war simulator. Pick a map and a year, from the Roman Empire to 2100, choose how many nations, press run, and the globe plays out on its own:
- Empires rise, split in civil wars and fall
- Leaders age, die and hand power to their heirs
- Pacts form and break, headlines print when history turns
- The Chronicle writes down everything that happened

Step in any time with god mode (gold, wars, peace, revolts, break up an empire), or take a seat and play the same world as one nation. Publish your world to THE ATLAS so anyone can watch it or remix it, make a postcard or a vertical clip, or open a world room with friends and AI leaders.

Free, no download, in 17 languages.

Build a world: https://secondstrike.io
Play the real-time war with the nuclear clock: https://secondstrike.io/war
Discord: https://discord.gg/Gkq4kXUhpM

#worldwarsimulator #mapping
